Put a block of footnotes below the table

Source: R/table_plan.R
plan_footnotes.Rd

plan_footnotes() gives the footnote lines printed a blank line below the table on each page, in the body of the page — not the section footer. One block serves every page; pages gives each page its own. The plan attaches them as the pages' rtf_footnotes attribute, which rtf_tables() prints as rtf_footnotes() does.

Usage

plan_footnotes(.plan, ..., pages = NULL, border = NULL)

Arguments

.plan

A table_plan().

...

The rows of one block, used on every page: strings, one a line, or a character vector of them.

pages

A list with one block per page, when the pages do not share one. Give ... or pages, never both.

border

NULL (default) for none, or an rtf_border() for the footnote block as a whole on every page of this table, read as rtf_footnotes()(border = ) is (rtf_border(top = TRUE) is the separator rule above the block). It is this table's own, so it wins over the document's rtf_footnotes()(border = ) and rtf_style()(footnotes = list(border = )). It is drawn in the table form (rtf_style(footnote_format = "table"), the default); the text form ignores it, with a warning.

Value

The plan, with one more layer.

See also

plan_verbs for every verb; plan_titles() for the block above; plan_empty() for a footnote added only when a table is empty.

Other plan verbs: plan_after(), plan_append(), plan_blanks(), plan_cell_style(), plan_cells(), plan_col_header(), plan_columns(), plan_compare(), plan_digits(), plan_empty(), plan_filter(), plan_hide(), plan_labels(), plan_levels(), plan_listing(), plan_nest(), plan_paginate_cols(), plan_paginate_group(), plan_paginate_rows(), plan_row_group(), plan_sort(), plan_stat_groups(), plan_stub(), plan_style(), plan_titles(), plan_total()

Examples

tbl <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Subjects", "Female, n (%)"),
  Placebo   = c("86", "53 (61.6)"),
  Active    = c("84", "50 (59.5)"))

# Minimal: one footnote line
pages <- table_plan(tbl) |>
  plan_footnotes("Percentages are of the subjects in each arm.") |>
  plan_apply()
attr(pages[[1]], "rtf_footnotes")
#> [1] "Percentages are of the subjects in each arm."

# Two pages cut by a row budget share one block of two lines: each
# page carries the same block
long <- data.frame(Subject = sprintf("01-%03d", 1:6),
                   Age = c(61, 58, 70, 66, 54, 49))
pages <- table_plan(long) |>
  plan_paginate_rows(max_rows = 3, split = "group_force") |>
  plan_footnotes(c("Age is at screening.", "Source: invented data.")) |>
  plan_apply()
lapply(pages, attr, "rtf_footnotes")
#> [[1]]
#> [1] "Age is at screening."   "Source: invented data."
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] "Age is at screening."   "Source: invented data."
#>
